title: C10 Drak
prompt: A colossal two-headed dragon made entirely of living bright orange chaos fire coils its long serpentine body in a spiral through the frame, both heads roar toward the left with glowing white-yellow eyes and open jaws, its scales are swirling flames and molten cracks, wide wings of fire behind, crackling orange chaos lightning runs along its body, orange embers and sparks everywhere. Background: dark smoky brown-black to deep red. Palette: deep red, burnt orange, bright yellow-orange, white-hot highlights, black, no teal. No text.

title: L01 Temny mag
prompt: Front view of one powerful dark mage sitting on a tall throne of jagged black obsidian crystal shards, he wears a deep black hood and long black robes embroidered with glowing bright orange chaos runes, his face is hidden in shadow except two burning orange eyes, his hands rest on the armrests with orange chaos energy crackling between his fingers, behind his head a huge glowing orange chaos sigil circle, floating black crystal shards, black candles with orange flames on the floor, swirling orange chaos smoke at his feet. Background: dark gothic hall in cold dark teal shadows, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.
